# Hand-maintained spelling vocabulary.
#
# Not here to correct prose. The point is the identifier that was misspelt once
# and has been called that ever since - a check finds that, a read-through never
# does. Everything below is a word that would otherwise drown that signal.
#
# Adding a word is a small decision with a long tail. The question to ask is
# "would a reader be right to think this is a typo?" - if yes, it belongs in the
# code differently, not here.

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The key alphabet, and the fixtures built from it.
#
# Crockford base32 with I, L, O and U removed. Every one of these is a run of
# that alphabet appearing in a test or in the documentation of it, and none of
# them is a word in any language.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AAEC
Aaosy
Bqfz
FTXZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZE
GHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ
Gpzb
HJKMN
HJKMNPQRSTVWXYZ
Ijoz
Ijpb
Kvgaduymqxm
PQRST
Swib
Tfrkh
ULTTPM
VWXYZ
WTGHJKMNPQRSTVWXYZF
YCRVFVAO
YUCAJE
vnwq
zzoa

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Deliberately wrong keys, used to prove the check symbol rejects them.
#
# Spelling them correctly would delete the test.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AAAAI
AAIAA
ILOU
IOIOI
OIOIH
OIOIO
TOOLONG

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Test key material.
#
# The Ed25519 key pair the shared vectors are signed with. It is checked into a
# repository, which disqualifies it from ever being anything but test material -
# and that is said next to it wherever it appears.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AKKB
BSKEs

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Operating system and platform names.
#
# Interfaces, tools and virtualisation markers the machine probe looks for. They
# are what the operating system calls them, not what we chose.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
AESGCM
bochs
dbus
gethostname
getpid
HKLM
ioreg
urandom
utun
vboxnet
veth
vmnet

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Tooling and configuration keys.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
addopts
testpaths

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Identifiers this package chose.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
bassboost
CONFUSABLES
vectobeat

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Words this repository spells deliberately.
#
# British forms, and coinages the prose uses more than once.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
abortably
serialiser
unparseable

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# German.
#
# Two places, both on purpose: the Discord bot example answers in the language
# VectoBeat's users speak, because an example that reads as a real command
# handler is worth more than one that reads as documentation; and one shared
# vector carries a non-ASCII payload, which is the entire point of that vector -
# it proves both editions serialise UTF-8 the same way rather than escaping it.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
aktiviert
bleibt
dauerhaft
Dauerbetrieb
dazugehört
gehören
gehört
Grüße
jetzt
Projekte
Sprachkanal
zeigt

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# People.

Hauke
